package internalapi

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
)

func (h *Handler) ReserveOnboardingPathAdmission(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !canonicalAdmissionStudentID(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")) {
		writeAdmissionPathError(w, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	if !hasOneCanonicalAdmissionKey(r) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	var v domain.OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest
	if !decodeAdmissionJSON(w, r, 64<<10, &v) {
		return
	}
	a, replay, e := h.OnboardingPathAdmissions.Reserve(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), singleAdmissionKey(r), v)
	writeAdmission(w, a, replay, e, http.StatusCreated)
}
func (h *Handler) RenewOnboardingPathAdmission(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !canonicalAdmissionStudentID(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")) {
		writeAdmissionPathError(w, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	if !canonicalAdmissionRouteID(chi.URLParam(r, "admissionID")) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if !hasOneCanonicalAdmissionKey(r) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	var v domain.OnboardingPathAdmissionRenewal
	if !decodeAdmissionJSON(w, r, 64<<10, &v) {
		return
	}
	if _, e := domain.NormalizeOnboardingPathAdmissionRenewal(v); e != nil {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	a, replay, e := h.OnboardingPathAdmissions.Renew(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "admissionID"), v.ExecutionID, singleAdmissionKey(r), v.Fence)
	writeAdmission(w, a, replay, e, http.StatusOK)
}
func (h *Handler) MaterializeOnboardingPathAdmission(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !canonicalAdmissionStudentID(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")) {
		writeAdmissionPathError(w, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	if !canonicalAdmissionRouteID(chi.URLParam(r, "admissionID")) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if !hasOneCanonicalAdmissionKey(r) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	var v domain.OnboardingPathMaterialization
	if !decodeAdmissionJSON(w, r, 1<<20, &v) {
		return
	}
	x, replay, e := h.OnboardingPathAdmissions.Materialize(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "admissionID"), singleAdmissionKey(r), v)
	if e != nil {
		writeAdmissionError(w, e)
		return
	}
	x.Replayed = replay
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if replay {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	} else {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(x)
}
func (h *Handler) AbortOnboardingPathAdmission(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !canonicalAdmissionStudentID(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")) {
		writeAdmissionPathError(w, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	if !canonicalAdmissionRouteID(chi.URLParam(r, "admissionID")) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if !hasOneCanonicalAdmissionKey(r) {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	var v domain.OnboardingPathAbort
	if !decodeAdmissionJSON(w, r, 64<<10, &v) {
		return
	}
	a, replay, e := h.OnboardingPathAdmissions.Abort(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "admissionID"), singleAdmissionKey(r), v)
	writeAdmission(w, a, replay, e, http.StatusOK)
}
func singleAdmissionKey(r *http.Request) string {
	v := r.Header.Values("Idempotency-Key")
	if len(v) != 1 || !canonicalAdmissionRouteID(v[0]) {
		return ""
	}
	return v[0]
}
func hasOneCanonicalAdmissionKey(r *http.Request) bool { return singleAdmissionKey(r) != "" }
func decodeAdmissionJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, n int64, v any) bool {
	ct, _, e := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if e != nil || ct != "application/json" {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return false
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, n))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if e = d.Decode(v); e != nil || d.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		writeAdmissionError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return false
	}
	return true
}
func writeAdmission(w http.ResponseWriter, a domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, replay bool, e error, created int) {
	if e != nil {
		writeAdmissionError(w, e)
		return
	}
	a.Replayed = replay
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if replay {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	} else {
		w.WriteHeader(created)
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(a)
}
func writeAdmissionError(w http.ResponseWriter, e error) {
	status, code := http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error"
	switch {
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled):
		status, code = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "onboarding_path_admission_disabled"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation):
		status, code = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrNotFound):
		status, code = http.StatusNotFound, "admission_not_found"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrStateChanged):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "state_changed"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrActivePathExists):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "active_path_exists"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrReservationExpired):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "reservation_expired"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrReservationConflict):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "reservation_conflict"
	case errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict):
		status, code = http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict"
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
func writeAdmissionPathError(w http.ResponseWriter, code string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}
func canonicalAdmissionStudentID(value string) bool {
	return canonicalAdmissionRouteID(value)
}
func canonicalAdmissionRouteID(value string) bool {
	id, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && id.String() == value
}
